title: Artificial Open World for Evaluating AGI: a Conceptual Design
reasoning: The paper proposes a conceptual framework for evaluating Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) based on its ability to adapt and solve problems in a simulated, open environment. The discussion is technical and philosophical, centered on the definition of intelligence and the mechanics of the proposed evaluation world. It does not address morals, ethics, or faith-based concepts as criteria for evaluation.
